sections.Problem Found: The cognitive agent had only 669 documents trained, almost entirely from samples/. Key directories had 0% coverage: cortical/ (0%), tests/ (0%), docs/ (0%), scripts/ (0%). The model could not answer questions about its own source code.
sections.Solution Applied:
1. Trained on cortical/ (267 files, 98.9% coverage)
2. Trained on tests/ (477 files, 99.8% coverage)
3. Trained on docs/ (302 files, 98.7% coverage)
4. Trained on scripts/ (112 files)
5. Reindexed IDF weights
6. Fixed bug with '.' directory entry in manifest
7. Fixed buggy Path truthiness check in rebuild-links

data.summary: Discovered and fixed critical training gap - cognitive agent was not trained on its own source code. Expanded training from 669 to 1845 documents. Added documentation to README.md and CLAUDE.md for future sessions.
data.title: Session 2026-01-12: Cognitive Agent Training Coverage Fix
